cases.setup: Provide a pinned public Python analyzer checkout and a quoted explicit TypeAlias reproduction. Bind current public inspection and reproduction oracles.
checks: The review record identifies current semantic owners and hashed code anchors rather than silently reusing historical paths.
The public reproduction's actual diagnostics and the quoted-function-annotation contrast are recorded.
The assessment records whether the marker is typing-aware and whether the annotation path resolves quoted expressions.
Absent or incompatible prerequisites are recorded as UNKNOWN or FAIL rather than treated as permission to edit.

cases.setup: Supply a current applicability-established routing assessment with compatible owners and observed TypeAlias initializer misrouting.
checks: The diff dispatches a present TypeAlias initializer to the existing annotation-processing path.
The diff uses the current typing-aware marker recognizer rather than a spelling-only test.
Target processing, declaration annotation processing, the absent-value guard, and ordinary initializer processing remain intact.
Public regression definitions cover quoted and unquoted aliases at module and class scope.
Public regression definitions include value-less aliases and an expected unused import for a type referenced by no initializer.
Pre-edit routing and validation facts are invalidated and the candidate is explicitly awaiting validation.

cases.setup: Provide a candidate change from the repair Action and executable current public oracle bindings. No hidden or gold-derived command is supplied.
checks: Rendered current argv commands and their actual execution results appear in the validation report.
The quoted and unquoted alias matrix at module and class scope produces the intended name-use behavior.
A value-less alias leaves an unrelated imported type unused.
The adapted original reproduction no longer emits the false unused-import diagnostic.
Quoted function annotations retain their previous behavior, and ordinary non-TypeAlias annotated values retain ordinary processing.
Any failure or unexecuted oracle remains FAIL or UNKNOWN; public-validation is recorded as passed only after all required checks pass.
The report states its tested scope and makes no whole-project, cross-project, or hidden-acceptance claim.
